title: Yellowed Resinous Northern Irish Aubergine Full English Breakfast Skillet
description: A hearty one-pot Northern Irish dish featuring aubergine and a resinous flavor, wrapped in a lotus leaf for a unique twist on the traditional Full English Breakfast.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the sausages until browned, then set aside.
Add the diced onions to the skillet and cook until translucent, then add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the diced aubergine to the skillet and cook until it starts to soften, then stir in the cooked sausages.
Create 4 wells in the skillet and crack an egg into each well.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then cover the skillet with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 15 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked to desired doneness.
Wrap each portion in a lotus leaf wrap and serve hot.
